clauses.clause: Liliana, Waker of the Dead {2}{B}{B} Legendary Planeswalker — Liliana loyalty 4 (cast)
clauses.evidence: [cast]: hand -> stack -> battlefield, card gets 4 LOYALTY counter(s), mana B-2 C-2.

[activate [0]] (and its five variants): loyalty 4 -> 5; 'ask discard' offers my hand (six cards), then the opponent's (opp_spare, opp_trick); each chosen card moves hand -> graveyard (you: hand 6 -> 5, opp: hand 2 -> 1). Packs J04_1 to J04_4 (each player's own choice; three players).

clauses.clause: Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.
clauses.evidence: In every [activate [0]] variant the opponent holds two cards and discards: no life change (the can-discard branch); no opponent with an empty hand is ever in the trace. Packs J04_1 (empty hand: loses 3), J04_2 (exactly one card: discards it and loses nothing), J04_3 (my empty hand costs me nothing), J04_4 (three players, each opponent judged alone).

clauses.clause: [−3]: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1]] on each of six creatures: loyalty 4 -> 1; X = 2 (my graveyard): 2/2s and a 1/1 die, the 4/4 giants and the 3/3 become 2/2 and 3/3 -> 1/1, and revert 'after the turn ends'. The standard board has two cards in each graveyard, so whose graveyard is counted is not in the trace: packs J04_5 (mine 2, theirs 3: X = 2, every card counts), J04_6 (mine 3, theirs 0; ends at end of turn), J04_7 (lethal).

clauses.clause: [−7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste."
clauses.evidence: 'ability [2] not activatable from battlefield: cost:loyalty:4<7'. Packs J04_8 (a creature card from the OPPONENT's graveyard returns under my control with haste and attacks), J04_9 (one from my own graveyard), J04_10 (only creature cards are targets), J04_11 (nothing at the opponent's combat). Pack J04_12 (two creature cards in the graveyards: only the targeted one returns).
